thread:
kevin: heads-up. we had a user-reported regression after we converted a model to ONNX+int8 last night. top-1 answers shifted on short prompts. attaching a minimal log snippet.

kevin: ```
input: "Translate: Hello"
fp32_out: "Hola"
onnx_int8_out: "Hol"
similarity: 0.76
```

maria_v: ugh. sounds like truncation or tokenizer mismatch at runtime, or sampling seed drift. did the conversion tool change token alignments?

kevin: conversion logs show tokenizer preserved, but attention outputs have lower magnitudes after quant. not sure if it's kernel precision or exporter scale tables.

bench-bot: I can add a small "runtime-compat" check to the pipeline. proposal: after bench stage, run converters (onnx, tvm) on a tiny set (N=32) of edge prompts: short, punctuation-heavy, non-ascii. compare canonicalized outputs with fp32 reference.

bench-bot: diff rules: normalize whitespace/quotes, strip trailing punctuation that may be sampling, compare token-level alignment and a tokenized-norm-bleu score. flag if token alignment mismatch > 2 tokens OR token-bleu < 0.9.

lina: I like token-level checks. for sampling models we need seeded sampling comparisons (top-k/top-p) and aggregate KL/divergence over the distribution. can't block purely for tiny KL changes though.

maria_v: agree. suggest two outcomes: FAIL (block) for alignment mismatches or deterministic output regression; WARN+RESTRICT for distribution drift on quantized paths. RESTRICTED models won't be auto-quantized.

ops_bot: for restricted models, console should show a clear badge and suggested remediation steps: re-export with different per-channel scales, try symmetric quant, or ask ML team for manual acceptance. include one-click create-ticket.

hugo: what's the runtime cost? running converters and small inference on 3 runtimes adds some cycles. can we reuse CI runners?

bench-bot: cost estimate: ~2 extra minutes per model using warm containers, ~0.05 GPU-hours. we can run in parallel and throttle concurrency to limit dollars. also cache converted binaries for repeat runs.

kevin: implementation detail: need a canonical serializer for outputs for stable diffs. bench-bot suggested rules, but we should add unicode normalization (NFKC) and float truncation to 4 decimals for logits.

maria_v: add a lightweight canary policy: if onboarding passes but model is restricted for quant, allow manual quant canary — route 0.5% traffic to quantized runtime for 24h with enhanced metrics. rollback on error spikes or perplexity regressions.

lina: will wire telemetry hooks: token-drop counts, response-length deltas, and KL signals. can show time-series in model page.

hugo: ok. roadmap: (1) bench-bot change for runtime-compat job (sampler + serializer), (2) onboarding pipeline stage name "runtime-compat", (3) console UX for restricted badge + ticket flow, (4) canary/runbook.

maria_v: i'll draft the pipeline addendum and PR template with thresholds. tagging @kevin for logs, @bench-bot for job impl, @lina for telemetry. will post draft in #eng-ml for review by EOW. :thumbsup:
